description: Several large plastic building blocks lie on a green bedsheet in front of a blue pillow, including a blue base block and smaller green, yellow, and white pieces. The left hand reaches in toward the green block while the right hand reaches toward the yellow block; both hands lift their pieces and press them onto the blue base, then the right hand picks up the white block and places it on top, briefly steadying it with the left hand as the pieces are aligned and pushed together.
